events.title: Midnight Rogues Launches On November 3!
events.summary: We’re so excited to share some big news with you: Midnight Rogues is launching on Steam on November 3!We can’t wait for you to experience the full game and save The City from these corrupt superheroes.We also have more news to share with you. We are taking part in October Next Fest, and we have a major demo update coming up with a new UI, new enemies, new sound effects, and more. We are working tirelessly on this update to get it live by Next Fest, and you can see a glimpse of it in this trailer

events.title: Play the Midnight Rogues Demo Now!
events.summary: We’re very excited to share that the Midnight Rogues demo is now available! You’ll have access to all the content for the first character, giving you a taste of what’s to come in the full game. We’re eager to hear your feedback and use it to make the final game as good as possible.We’re also revealing the full game’s price: Midnight Rogues will launch on Steam at $6.99 USD, with regional pricing and a launch discount.Try the free demo today, and wishlist the full game if you’d like to play more!

events.title: Midnight Rogues Demo Page Is Live | Play September 30
events.summary: Our first public Midnight Rogues demo arrives on September 30! Its separate Steam page is live now, so you can take a look before the demo becomes playable.Midnight Rogues is a roguelike auto-battler where you collect items and arrange them across a tableau. When combat begins, a timer activates them in sequence. Change their placement or activation order, and the same items can create a very different combination.We’re looking forward to seeing the sequences you build when the demo goes live.Vi
